description: One Forever NPC: agreed name and map pins, and loot windows reported but not yet in the rates. A name or pin needs 3 installs agreeing. The pin does not require a drop. No copied spawn list. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.
name: npc_page

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

pendingLoot.description: Loot windows reported but not yet in the rates. Absent when there are none.

windows.description: Reported loot windows not yet in the rates.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: NPC page
